method: Visual inspection of actual final native Shipping PNGs and matching successful launch/state records. Every included PNG/report/state triplet is pinned after inspection to its exact SHA-256, bytes and UTC review time. Native PE SHA-256 5a209be2b0d17cf7f2aebfc41c9eff9e52e791b1da8b8c1cb1c93d8d9b1a322e. No Editor, older or unseen frames reused.

captures.observation: Actual 1920x1080 paused real-projectile frame inspected. Gold arrow tips and cyan magical heads are visible around release paths; the large 35-degree field and centered bottom hand fit safely. State records nine live projectile bodies and nine launch events across the real fixture, nine particles and paused timing; healthy unit/structure HP is hidden. This still frame does not by itself establish animation timing.

Actual 1920x1080 live combat at capture delay 5.2 seconds inspected. Enlarged models, damaged-unit HP bars, CHARGE status and three-second field radius remain readable; healthy structures have no HP display. Combat effects are restrained in this instant, with 32 particles, 24 projectile bodies created and 23 released recorded. All actual model and health-anchor bounds are safe; no HUD collision observed.

Actual 1280x720 maximum requested UI scale 1.4 inspected with third card selected. Centered four-card dock is below the player Core; complete names, costs, keys, NEXT, Aether count/segments and timer fit. All 38 healthy visuals show no HP bars/numbers while DORMANT and building lifetime remain. Actual ground width 507.0625 pixels, troop minimum/mean height 33.721/56.733 pixels across 30 troops; full legal field, 16-point envelope and actual model/anchor bounds pass. Models are visibly larger with natural front/rear order and no HUD overlap.

Actual 1280x720 requested UI scale 1.4 inspected with fourth card selected and Training Lab open. Same centered bottom hand/card size and complete Aether row fit; selected card does not overlap the meter. Full inspector remains left, notice and scrollable developer controls remain right above the dock. Ground width 507.0625 pixels and troop minimum height 33.721 pixels; all 38 actual model/anchor bounds safe. Healthy HP hidden, status/lifetime retained, no HUD overlap observed.

Actual final native 1920x1080 Home inspected. Navigation, currencies, battle/training actions, deck readout and eight active model portraits fit cleanly. Portrait models are complete, including the Manta wings, and names/costs remain readable.

Actual final native 1920x1080 Loadout inspected. Five deck presets, all eight opening/queued slots, model portraits, full names, costs, readiness text and save/test/reset controls fit without overlapping. Analysis and collection remain in the scrollable content; visible portraits have no clipped limbs or wings.

Actual final native 1920x1080 collection inspected. All fourteen production-model portraits appear with full names and costs; Twin Blades/bats members, Manta/Raven wings, tower and spell silhouettes fit their cards. Two-row collection, category labels and deck action remain readable without overlapping.

Actual final native 1920x1080 Ironclad detail inspected. Full model portrait, six stat tiles, target/role information and matchup/partner cards fit cleanly; miniature portraits remain recognizable. Back control and scrollable extended detail are present; no overlapping text observed.

Actual final native 1920x1080 Settings inspected. Display/performance choices, four audio sliders, UI scale, camera speed, deployment preferences and Apply/Save action remain visible and legible. Dropdowns and numerical readouts fit their rows without overlapping.

Actual final native 1920x1080 Field Manual inspected. Three instruction columns have readable key/click/drag/cancel/pause/zoom/developer controls and battle rules. Text wraps within its columns; later sections remain in scrollable content, with no overlapping visible labels.

Actual final native 1920x1080 Replays inspected after a newly generated recorded AI match. New record, timestamps, size and Watch/Analysis/Export/Remove controls fit the list; import path/control and scrollable history remain readable without overlapping.

Actual final native 1920x1080 replay inspected at the recorded 99-second seek point. Large full field fits above transport/timeline/key-event controls; navigation and battle-event sidebar remain readable. Four previously damaged entities have HP displays while healthy Core structures retain only DORMANT; actual model/anchor bounds pass and no HUD overlap observed.

Actual final native 1920x1080 recorded match analysis inspected. Victory/crowns/duration, player deck model miniatures, aggregate Aether figures and all eight visible contribution rows fit cleanly. Opponent section remains scrollable; Watch Replay remains visible, with no overlapping table values.

Actual final native 1920x1080 Meta Lab inspected. Throughput/archive controls, nine report tabs, search/filter/version/export controls and visible sorted card metrics fit. Table names, percentage columns, intervals and sample counts are readable; long version identifier is bounded within its dropdown and lower rows remain scrollable.

Actual final native 1920x1080 Patch Notes inspected. Current 1.2.0 model/motion update, centered hand and first-damage health behavior are visible above preserved 1.1.0 and 1.0.0 text. Paragraphs wrap within the page without overlapping navigation or currency controls.

Actual final native 1920x1080 default battle inspected. Full arena and six crown structures fit at the 35-degree nearest safe camera; ground width is approximately 934 pixels. Same compact four-card dock, NEXT and complete Aether meter sit centered below player Core. Healthy structures show DORMANT without HP numbers or bars; header, inspector, notice and utility controls remain clear.

Actual final native 1280x800 16:10 combat inspected. Ground width 672.573 pixels; full legal field, conservative model envelope and actual models/health anchors remain above centered bottom dock and clear of side panels. Card names/costs/NEXT/Aether and timer fit; damaged HP/status/radius information is readable while healthy structure HP stays hidden.

Actual final native 2560x1080 21:9 combat inspected. Ground width 934.428 pixels with large models and natural depth order; extra horizontal room keeps inspector/notice separated. Same-size compact dock stays centered beneath Core. Field/envelope/actual model bounds pass, damaged HP is visible, healthy HP hidden, and no HUD collision observed.

Actual final native 1920x1080 Frost breath roster fixture inspected at requested delay 1.2 seconds. Enlarged troop/wing silhouettes and centered bottom dock fit safely; damaged-only bars and building lifetime remain readable. Muzzle effects are small in this still; state records breathSmoke true, two Frost puff systems with eight particles each (16 Frost particles), plus 48 Nova particles from real Arc Mage hits for 64 total world particles. No claim of full animation timing is derived from this single image.

Actual final native 1920x1080 paused Archer Tower placement preview inspected. Cyan legal footprint is visible above player Core within the legal half of the enlarged arena. All six healthy crown structures retain status without HP bars/numbers; same compact hand and Aether row remain centered below Core with clear HUD gutters.

Actual final native 1920x1080 paused battle menu inspected. Dimmed battlefield and centered hand remain behind the modal. Resume, Settings, Loadout, Field Manual, Restart and Exit controls fit the complete panel, with readable labels and no clipping.

Actual final native 1920x1080 tiebreaker inspected. Persistent TIEBREAKER banner and phase timer are readable; hand is disabled while NEXT/Aether remain visible in centered dock. All six crown structures now show HP after actual tiebreaker damage, with separate DORMANT status retained. Numerical HP, banner, full field and HUD remain clear; actual model/anchor bounds pass.

Actual final native 1920x1080 victory inspected after enemy Core destruction. Complete VICTORY modal shows three-zero crowns, cause and Play Again/Analysis/Replay/Home controls. Disabled bottom hand remains beneath the player Core, with intact NEXT and Aether display; remaining healthy structures have no HP bars. All surviving model/anchor bounds pass, with no clipped modal text.

Actual final native 1920x1080 double-Aether transition inspected at delay 1.2 seconds. Complete 2x AETHER banner is centered and readable; regulation timer shows 0:59 and centered dock shows full bank plus 2x Aether. All healthy crown structures remain free of HP bars/numbers, full field/model bounds pass and fixed HUD controls stay clear.

Actual final native 1920x1080 triple-Aether transition inspected at delay 1.2 seconds. Complete 3x AETHER banner is centered and readable; overtime timer shows 0:59 and full-bank dock retains 3x Aether. Healthy crown structures retain only DORMANT status; full field/model bounds and compact hand fit safely.

Actual final native 1920x1080 overtime transition inspected at delay 1.2 seconds. Full OVERTIME - SUDDEN DEATH announcement fits inside its banner, with 1:59 timer and 2x Aether. Centered same-size dock remains below player Core; healthy HP hidden, status retained, and all field/model bounds safe.
